children.name: type
children.description:
The type of the promotion:

- `standard` indicates that a promotion is a standard one applied with conditions.
- `buyget` indicates that a promotion is a "Buy X get Y" promotion.

children.name: status
children.description:
The status of the promotion:

- `active` promotion is available for user to consume
- `inactive` promotion is no longer available to the user
- `draft` promotion is currently being prepared

children.name: is_automatic
children.description: Whether the promotion is applied automatically.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the promotion is tax inclusive.

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of times this promotion can be used across all orders.

children.name: used
children.description: The number of times this promotion has been used in completed orders.

children.name: type
children.description:
The type of the application method indicating how
the associated promotion is applied.

children.name: target_type
children.description:
The target type of the application method indicating
whether the associated promotion is applied to the cart's items,
shipping methods, or the whole order.

children.name: allocation
children.description:
The allocation value that indicates whether the associated promotion
is applied on each item in a cart or split between the items in the cart.

children.name: value
children.description: The discounted amount applied by the associated promotion based on the `type`.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of the application method

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The max quantity allowed in the cart for the associated promotion to be applied.

children.name: buy_rules_min_quantity
children.description:
The minimum quantity required for a `buyget` promotion to be applied.
For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the
value of this attribute is `2`.

children.name: apply_to_quantity
children.description:
The quantity that results from matching the `buyget` promotion's condition.
For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the value
of this attribute is `1`.
